shortDescription: Module for CyberArk Account object creation, deletion, modification, and password retrieval using PAS Web Services SDK.

options.name: address
options.description: The address of the endpoint where the privileged account is located.

options.name: api_base_url
options.description: A string containing the base URL of the server hosting CyberArk's Privileged Account Security Web Services SDK. Example U(https://<IIS_Server_Ip>/PasswordVault/api/)

options.name: cyberark_session
options.description: Dictionary set by a CyberArk authentication containing the different values to perform actions on a logged-on CyberArk session, please see M(cyberark.pas.cyberark_authentication) module for an example of cyberark_session.

options.name: identified_by
options.description: When an API call is made to Get Accounts, often times the default parameters passed will identify more than one account. This parameter is used to confidently identify a single account when the default query can return multiple results.

options.name: logging_file
options.description: Setting the log file name and location for troubleshooting logs.

options.name: logging_level
options.description: Parameter used to define the level of troubleshooting output to the C(logging_file) value.

options.name: new_secret
options.description: The new secret/password to be stored in CyberArk Vault.

options.name: platform_account_properties
options.description: Object containing key-value pairs to associate with the account, as defined by the account platform. These properties are validated against the mandatory and optional properties of the specified platform's definition. Optional properties that do not exist on the account will not be returned here. Internal properties are not returned.

options.name: platform_id
options.description: The PolicyID of the Platform that is to be managing the account

options.name: remote_machines_access
options.description: Set of parameters for defining PSM endpoint access targets.

options.name: safe
options.description: The safe in the Vault where the privileged account is to be located.

options.name: secret
options.description: The initial password for the creation of the account

options.name: secret_management
options.description: Set of parameters associated with the management of the credential.

options.name: secret_type
options.description: The value that identifies what type of account it will be.

options.name: state
options.description: Assert the desired state of the account C(present) to create or update and account object. Set to C(absent) for deletion of an account object. Set to C(retrieve) to get the account object including the password.

options.name: username
options.description: The username associated with the account.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificate chain will not be validated.  This should only set to C(true) if you have a root CA certificate installed on each node.
